title: 2021 HMMT November Theme Problem 3
statement: Let \(n\) be the answer to this problem. Hexagon \(A B C D E F\) is inscribed in a circle of radius 90 . The area of \(A B C D E F\) is \(8 n, A B=B C=D E=E F\), and \(C D=F A\). Find the area of triangle \(A B C\).

solutions.text:
Let \(O\) be the center of the circle, and let \(O B\) intersect \(A C\) at point \(M\); note \(O B\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(A C\). Since triangles \(A B C\) and \(D E F\) are congruent, \(A C D F\) has area \(6 n\), meaning that \(A O C\) has area \(3 n / 2\). It follows that \(\frac{B M}{O M}=\frac{2}{3}\). Therefore \(O M=54\) and \(M B=36\), so by the Pythagorean theorem, \(M A=\sqrt{90^{2}-54^{2}}=72\). Thus, \(A B C\) has area \(72 \cdot 36=2592\).
